generate_images_with_ddim: generate images from noise using the DDIMPipeline with a specified number of inference steps
create_ddim_pipeline: create a DDIMPipeline instance by loading a pretrained UNet2DModel and DDIMScheduler from a model checkpoint
run_ddim_inference: run the DDIMPipeline call method with a custom eta value to control the DDIM versus DDPM behavior
review_ddim_eta_parameter: review the DDIMPipeline eta parameter to understand how values between 0 and 1 affect denoising
refactor_ddim_output_type: refactor the DDIMPipeline call to return numpy arrays instead of PIL images by setting output_type
